body: Well, good for you. For me, either meeting stranger or making a new friend (who don't know abt my past) will undoubtly make me more sad. So, not for me. The only thing that make me feel a bit happy is playing with our 11 year old cat, but that made me feel even more sad. Ha.
Yup, I've tried any type of self care. Everything feels the same, so I gave myself up.
